purpose: Teach: アタマ/境地/ワザ/実話/唖然/シリアス/ファイト/頭上

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アタマが冴える朝に来店されるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, customers who come in during those sharp, clear mornings—they're different, aren't they?
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to herself. Noticing a pattern without needing confirmation. Warm curiosity. Gentle pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お茶の境地を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That regular was talking about tea like it was a kind of meditation today. Did you hear?
lines.style: Light, conversational turn. Sharing something noticed. Genuine interest in what Mei thinks. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ラテアートのワザを磨こうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's keep working on your latte art together, okay? You're getting really good.
lines.style: Encouraging without being pushy. Matter-of-fact warmth. Recognition that matters because it's honest. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、実話に基づく小説の話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was telling us about a novel based on a true story. Really invested in it.
lines.style: Sharing an observation. Soft appreciation for how people open up. Quiet delight at human detail. No urgency.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューに唖然とされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did you see how taken aback that person was by the new menu? Kind of funny, actually.
lines.style: Wry but not unkind. Light amusement at the small moment. Conspiratorial tone—inviting Mei to see it too. Slight smile underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、シリアスなクレームには丁寧に対応しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: When customers get serious about something they're upset with, let's make sure we respond with real care, all right?
lines.style: Gentle teaching, not lecturing. Assuming Mei wants to do this right. Calm, clear guidance. The voice of someone who's handled this before.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新人にファイトと声をかけようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Make sure to give the new hire some encouragement, yeah? They need to know we've got them.
lines.style: Direct kindness. Speaking from experience about what newer people need to hear. Warm but practical. A beat of sincerity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、頭上のシャンデリアを磨こうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Don't forget to polish that chandelier up there when you get a chance.
lines.style: Small task mentioned like a gentle reminder. Not demanding. Quiet practicality. The tone of someone who cares about how a space feels.
